criteria.name: Correct identity and source-backed footprint
criteria.evidence: Independent Blender reopen and raw official Purdue GIS snapshot: FID 796 identifies SOFDH / Phi Delta Theta, 503 State St, owner GREEK. The 30-vertex source ring and 30 shell base vertices have symmetric nearest-vertex XY Hausdorff error 0.00001552 m. GIS crosswalk is direct by name, abbreviation, and address.

criteria.name: Position, orientation, and scale/dimensions
criteria.evidence: The simple massing asset is in campus coordinates. Independently measured shell bounds match converted GIS bounds; the direct transformed ring preserves plan orientation and scale. The source is EPSG:4326 converted with the repository local approximation, not a surveyed projected CRS; campus position is therefore source-derived, not independently surveyed.

criteria.name: Evidence-backed height, floors, and roof form
criteria.evidence: The saved 2017 chapter photo directly shows three occupied levels and multi-part dark roof masses; it supports general story count and roof silhouette. The model eave/wall levels and peaks (10.15 m and up to 13.26 m by independent Blender evaluation) are estimates without scale or elevations. GIS has Extrution=12, but the service metadata defines no units or height semantics, so that field cannot validate the model dimensions.

criteria.name: Facade, entrances, and distinctive architecture
criteria.evidence: Direct comparison of the archived Purdue chapter photo with the street-facade render supports the brick lower facade, light upper siding, three-level window rhythm, centered classical portico, balcony, triangular pediment and round vent. The photo is one oblique 2017 view without scale; exact proportions, detailed cornice/column work, facade dimensions, and unphotographed elevations remain uncertain.

criteria.name: Modular export, portability, and complete evidence
criteria.evidence: Independently reopened the actual .blend in Blender 5.2.3 LTS: expected scene and collection exist; the collection has 313 objects (309 mesh, 4 curve/font); it is present once in the scene; no external image paths or temporary render objects; required source snapshots and four renders exist. However the shared manifest still describes one object and unrelated old bounds/status, so index consistency is incomplete and requires coordinator correction.

manifest_entry.accuracy_status: Named OSM way 860901797 and official map pin independently verified; 9 structural vertices match within 0.000015 m; photo-backed exterior details; height and roof dimensions estimated; see ../audit/massing_our_saviour_lutheran_church_118afa2/independent_grade.json

findings.finding: All vertical measurements, floor heights, roof pitches, and roof peak values remain estimated; the oblique 2017 photo has no scale. GIS Extrution=12 has no documented units/meaning in the service metadata.

modular/manifest.json is stale for this asset: it reports object_count=1, old bounds, and an unrelated accuracy_status/evidence path, while the reopened asset has 313 collection objects and campus extents approximately X 67.52–110.81, Y -417.52–-390.17, Z 0–13.26 m. Shared manifest edits are outside grader ownership.
Esri imagery acquisition date is unavailable; facade evidence is from a 2017 chapter photo and hidden elevations are schematic.
